AIR-COOLED COMPRESSOR AND BOOSTER UNITS
BM SERIES
The BAUER BM series offers a wide power range from 7.5 - 110 kW with delivery
rates from 470 - 6,200 l/min. The compressors are available in a 2-stage version for
discharge pressures up to 30 bar or in a 3-stage version for discharge pressures up
to 40 bar and 100 bar.
Low centre of gravity with the ability to operate at inclinations up to 30° under
motion makes this an ideal product for shipboard and
offshore applications.
MINI-VERTICUS and VERTICUS SERIES
The new MINI-VERTICUS and VERTICUS combine the legendary BAUER compressor blocks with improved
­components and ultra-modern design! During the redesign, the focus was on ergonomics, making operation
as easy as possible, reducing noise and boosting efficiency.
Suitable for all common, non-aggressive gases and gas mixtures, these compressors can be used in practically
every industrial application.
Storage units, gas measuring systems, an extensive range of accessories and purification systems that can be
integrated complete these compact system solutions.

Options
Super Silent version
The Super Silent enclosure significantly reduces the sound pressure level of the compressor system and enables the connection of an exhaust duct. Its effective sound insulation ensures quieter operation and can also be retrofitted if required.
B-CONTROL III
The B-CONTROL III is the premium control system for complex applications. Its 7-inch touchscreen display provides a user-friendly visualization of all operating data. Features such as a data logger, USB interface, Remote HMI, and protocols including OPC UA, Modbus, and CAN bus are integrated. The control system supports up to four compressors in a network and can be expanded flexibly.
Soft start
For a smooth start-up of your system, the use of a soft starter is recommended, as it significantly reduces the starting current. From a motor power of 75 kW and above, this function is included as standard in combination with the B-CONTROL control system. Alternatively, a frequency converter can be used. In addition to enabling soft starting, it allows the delivery rate to be adjusted according to actual demand, helping to reduce energy consumption – for maximum efficiency and operational reliability.
Monitoring of intermediate pressures and intermediate stage temperatures
